KeyOverride.description: What a guild decided about one permission key (`moderation.ban`).

deny.description: Never allowed (except the owner of the server); wins over `allow`.

min_level.description: The level a member needs, instead of the one the module declared.

Language.description:
The language of messages the bot sends in a guild: `auto` follows the community locale the
server chose in Discord, otherwise a locale tag such as `en` or `ja`.

LevelSetting.description: A level written as its name (`moderator`) or as a number from 1 to 100.

capabilities.description: Narrows what the module may do. It can never exceed what the module declares.

config.description: Module specific settings, validated against the module's own schema.

PermissionsOverride.description:
Who may do what. A member's level is the highest that any of their roles, their own entry
or Discord's Administrator permission gives; the owner of the server is always at 100.

administrator_level.description: The level of a member who holds Discord's Administrator permission (default `admin`).

anyOf.description: Permission key (`moderation.ban`) to what is decided about it.
Role id to level.
User id to level.

Preset.description:
A starting point sized for the server. It only chooses defaults; every value can still be
overridden individually.

description:
The sparse document an administrator writes: only what differs from the defaults. This is
what is stored, edited by the dashboard form and exchanged as YAML.
